conclusion: The reviewer conclusions cannot be validated from the supplied materials because no allowed/citable evidence identifiers were provided. Consequently, all substantive assertions in the reviewer conclusions are unsupported in the current record.
unsupported_assertions: "Insufficient source-supported clinical evidence exists in the supplied state to endorse any particular jurisdiction as an appropriate first clinical development partner for SGL-001." — reviewer cites no evidence ids to substantiate absence or presence of clinical-translatable data.

"Key translational gaps (uncertain large-animal/ human CNS exposure after intranasal delivery; undefined clinical indication; unfinished potency and release assays; incomplete GMP-scale demonstration) prevent a defensible clinical pathway recommendation at this time." — no evidence ids provided to document these specific gaps or to show attempts to address them.

"There is no jurisdiction-specific regulatory pathway supported by the supplied materials that can currently be stated as legitimately enabling a first clinic relationship." — no jurisdictional guidance, regulator engagement records, or jurisdiction-specific precedent evidence ids were supplied to verify this conclusion.

"From a commercial-partnership perspective, no single jurisdiction can be recommended now as the legitimate first-clinic partner because critical de-risking ... remains incomplete." — no market, CMC scale-up, or partner-due-diligence evidence ids were supplied to support this commercial assessment.

Requested evidence lists (GLP large-animal reports; human/compassionate-use safety reports; validated potency assays; GMP batch records; regulator engagement minutes; market and reimbursement analyses; cost/timeline estimates; MOUs) — none of these documents were supplied as citable evidence ids, so the absence of those items cannot be verified from the record.
